run_MapAnything_infer: run the MapAnything model infer method to predict 3D pointmaps, depth, and camera poses from input images
run_MapAnything_forward: run the MapAnything model forward pass to encode views and produce scene representations with optional geometric inputs
build_MapAnything_model: build a MapAnything model instance by providing encoder, info sharing, prediction head, and geometric input configs
run_MapAnything_downstream_head: run the downstream prediction heads to produce dense outputs, pose outputs, and scale predictions from transformer features
review_MapAnything_initialization: review the MapAnything model initialization to understand encoder factory, multi-view transformer, and adaptor setup
